observations: The ordinary sign-in redirected to the native Odoo WebClient.
The workspace trigger opened with Enter. Selecting the authorized workspace opened a separate tab.
The workspace Notes action opened the native list and form.
The Arabic workspace menu showed translated Notes, Canvas, platform settings and Notes tools.
An existing session switched to Arabic in the fixture required one refresh for the RTL stylesheet.
The native Arabic form then used RTL body and text input directions with no stylesheet fallback.
